projects.title: Projects
projects.description: A selection of projects I've built. Each one is a live preview you can interact with.

list.name: Dogs
list.description: A social network for sharing dog photos. Built with Next.js and TypeScript, with forms validated using React Hook Form and Zod and an interface styled with Tailwind CSS.

list.name: Tibia Tools
list.description: A tool for calculating character speed in Tibia. Built with Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, it provides a dedicated interface for looking up and calculating in-game speed.

list.name: Swars
list.description: A social network inspired by the Star Wars universe. Developed with React and JavaScript, it combines an SCSS-styled interface with REST API integration.
